taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-01, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1056.4 | 23.97 | 23.97
2 | 1090.4 | 1.46 | 25.43
3 | 2606.8 | 3.17 | 28.60
4 | 3560.6 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation for the given VES data, we first list the resistivities of the layers in depth order:
- $\rho_1 = 1056.4 \, \Omega\text{m}$
- $\rho_2 = 1090.4 \, \Omega\text{m}$
- $\rho_3 = 2606.8 \, \Omega\text{m}$
- $\rho_4 = 3560.6 \, \Omega\text{m}$

Since there are $N = 4$ layers, the curve will have $N - 2 = 2$ letters. We analyze each group of three consecutive layers:

1.  **Group 1 (Layers 1, 2, and 3):**
    Compare $\rho_1$, $\rho_2$, and $\rho_3$:
    $1056.4 < 1090.4 < 2606.8$
    Since $\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3$, this corresponds to the letter **A**.

2.  **Group 2 (Layers 2, 3, and 4):**
    Compare $\rho_2$, $\rho_3$, and $\rho_4$:
    $1090.4 < 2606.8 < 3560.6$
    Since $\rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4$, this also corresponds to the letter **A**.

The sequence of letters is **AA**. According to the instructions, if all the letters are the same, the curve may be written as that single letter. Therefore, the curve type is **A**.

{"curve_type": "A"}
